bibliography.title: Mixture-of-Experts Can Surpass Dense LLMs Under Strictly Equal Resource

sections.title: B Extended Analysis on Related Work
F The Use of Large Language Models: An Explanation

abstract_sentences.text: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models dramatically expand model capacity and achieve remarkable performance without increasing per-token compute.
However, can MoEs surpass dense architectures under strictly equal resource constraints — that is, when the total parameter count, training compute, and data budget are identical?

evidence.anchor: total parameter count, training compute, and data budget

abstract_sentences.text: This question remains under-explored despite its significant practical value and potential.
In this paper, we propose a novel perspective and methodological framework to study this question thoroughly.
First, we comprehensively investigate the architecture of MoEs and achieve an optimal model design that maximizes the performance.

Based on this, we subsequently find that an MoE model with activation rate in an optimal region is able to outperform its dense counterpart under the same total parameter, training compute and data resource.
More importantly, this optimal region remains consistent across different model sizes.
Although additional amount of data turns out to be a trade-off for enhanced performance, we show that this can be resolved via reusing data.
We validate our findings through extensive experiments, training nearly 200 language models at 2B scale and over 50 at 7B scale, cumulatively processing 50 trillion tokens.
All model checkpoints are publicly available.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把 MoE 优势问题改写为 fixed total N、training C、unique data D 的三重约束比较；Eq.(1)–(10) 将 AR 连接到 per-token compute 和 data demand，三步路线再用 optimized backbone、fixed-N/C sweep、strict/loose reuse 闭合主线（pp.4–10）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题、三步方法、AR≈20% 曲线、2B dense 差值 0.0064/0.0049、7B consistency、data reuse 结论、下游总体趋势和三项限制（pp.2、5–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 结构参数、完整 N/C/D/epoch/η/B/iters、data recipe、29 个 benchmark 名单和 architecture/reuse ablation 移到 Appendices C–E；严格等资源逐行核验依赖 Tables 9–17（pp.17–21）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1/2 用同一 BPC–AR 视图叠加 fixed-D、fixed-C、reuse 和 dense reference，公式链先给可检查的成本关系，Table 2 再将分组趋势回收到逐 benchmark 行（pp.6–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: expert specialization 只是未测 conjecture；greedy 搜索不等于全局最优，N≫7B 未验证，且没有 seed、误差、硬件或 contamination 控制，读者需手工重建不同 data/compute 分母（pp.5–10、17、19–21）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 稀疏与 dense 架构比较应先统一参数化并固定总 N 与 per-token compute，再将 AR、累计 C、unique D 与 reuse epochs 拆成正交实验，同时展示曲线、明确 dense 差值和逐项不利结果（pp.4–10）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合固定部署内存与训练预算的 MoE 架构比较；若问题涉及跨硬件 latency、MFU、超 7B 规模或 specialization 机制，需增加硬件、路由诊断和独立重复设计，不能直接外推约 20% AR（pp.8、10、17）。
